title: sealedsecret-choreographer: orchestrate multi-CA key rotation with Vault bridge and safe rollback
author: Nora Kim
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private on-prem have asked for an automated, auditable orchestration for rotating TLS/CA keys and sealed-secret wrapping keys across clusters where Vault is the authoritative KMS. This PR introduces the 'sealedsecret-choreographer' controller + supporting Helm and Terraform changes that coordinate: 1) staged CA rollover across control-plane and user services, 2) rotation of Vault transit keys used to wrap sealed secrets, and 3) a safe rollback path that can re-seal with the prior key if healthchecks fail.

What this PR does (single-line string — sections merged): Adds a new Kubernetes controller (sealedsecret-choreographer) that watches SealedSecret/Secret resources and a new custom resource SealedRotationPlan that describes an ordered rollout. The controller drives Vault key material promotion via a small bridge process (vault-bridge) and emits progress events to the Redwood operator. Helm: new chart 'sealedsecret-choreographer' with configurable canary percentage, concurrency, and pre/post hooks for tenant namespaces. Terraform: adds tf module 'vault_key_promotion' that creates wrapped key versions and exposes outputs consumed by installer bootstrap. Installer: wiring to the private-installer umbrella chart and upgrade job to perform a dry-run followed by canary rollouts. Safety: preflight checks (certificate chain validation, KV cache warmup), health probes, and automatic pause on >2 consecutive failures. All changes are opt-in behind the installer flag enableSealedChoreographer=true.

Checklist (manual integration steps performed): - [x] End-to-end dry-run in local KinD cluster against test Vault with HSM-simulator - [x] Terraform plan applied in staging to create secondary key versions - [x] Helm install of operator chart in staging with canary=10% - [x] Integration smoke tests for SealedSecret unwrap/rewrap under rotation - [x] Rollback test (forced failure during canary) validated automatic recovery

Upgrade notes and rollback: The installer adds a pre-upgrade job that performs a dry-run and records migration-plan objects in a sealed secret. The controller can replay that plan to resume or revert. Rollback triggers a deterministic rewrap using the prior Vault key version; operator adds a status.condition indicating rollback reason.

Security review: Vault bridge runs with least privilege IAM policies for transit:encrypt/decrypt only and key lifecycle read. All communication between bridge and Vault uses mTLS and additional attestation (measured boot token is optional). Sealed secrets remain encrypted using controller-managed keys and are never stored in plaintext in the control plane during transition.

Related linear tickets: ENG-4928 (rotation orchestration), SRE-210 (installer safety hooks).
